2608.09253.title: SkillSentry: Reliable Skill Execution for LLM Agents via Runtime Assurance
2608.09253.paper_summary: LLM agents are increasingly equipped with skills to perform complex tasks through multi-step reasoning and tool use. Although skills provide reusable procedural knowledge, agents may still execute them unreliably. Even when an agent has demonstrated the capability to complete tasks under the guidance of a skill, it may fail to do so consistently across similar tasks or repeated runs due to deviations from the skill procedure or incorrect execution of individual steps. Such instability limits the practical reliability of LLM agents. To address this problem, we propose SkillSentry, a skill-oriented runtime assurance framework built upon a new domain-specific language (DSL) for representing runtime guidance for skill execution. SkillSentry initializes the runtime guidance by combining a skill specification extracted from the corresponding skill document with execution experience mined from historical successful and failed traces. It then wraps around the agent execution loop to monitor and guide skill execution under the current guidance, while iteratively refining the guidance using newly collected traces. We evaluate SkillSentry on 15 skills across two LLM agents, each paired with two backbone models, i.e., Claude Code with Claude-Haiku-4.5 and Claude-Opus-4.6, and Codex with GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.4. Our results show that SkillSentry improves the task success rate of LLM agents by 24.1% across skills, on average, while exhibiting lower variability across repeated runs.
2608.09253.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理人越來越多地具備透過多步推理和工具使用執行複雜任務的技能。雖然技能提供可重用的程序知識，但代理人仍然可能不可靠地執行這些技能。即使代理人在技能的指導下展示了完成任務的能力，它在類似任務或重複運行中仍可能無法一致地做到這一點，這是因為偏離了技能程序或個別步驟的執行不正確。這種不穩定性限制了 LLM 代理人的實際可靠性。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了 SkillSentry，一個以技能為導向的運行時保證框架，基於一種新的特定領域語言 (DSL)，用於表示技能執行的運行時指導。SkillSentry 通過將從相應技能文檔中提取的技能規範與從歷史成功和失敗痕跡中挖掘的執行經驗結合來初始化運行時指導。然後，它包裹在代理執行循環中，以監控和指導在當前指導下的技能執行，同時使用新收集的痕跡不斷改進指導。我們在兩個 LLM 代理人上評估了 SkillSentry，這兩個代理人各自配對了兩個骨幹模型，即 Claude Code 與 Claude-Haiku-4.5 和 Claude-Opus-4.6，以及 Codex 與 GPT-5.2 和 GPT-5.4。我們的結果顯示，SkillSentry 在技能上平均提高了 LLM 代理人的任務成功率 24.1%，同時在重複運行中表現出較低的變異性。
